text:
raj: Ran overnight fused-paged Flash variants on prod-staging. Seeing ~20% tail latency regression at 512 conc vs last week. KV cache miss rate spikes during bursts.
maria: Can you paste profiler output / nvprof flame? any smem or mem BW hot spots?
raj: Here's the perf dump from perf-run-2934:
```
kernel: flash_fused_paged_v2
smem_util: 78%
mem_bw: 420GB/s
kv_miss_rate: 12.3%
avg_lat_ms: 34.2
p95_ms: 76.1
p99_ms: 124.8
warp_stalls: 18%
shared_bank_conflicts: 6%
```
sam: Did batching heuristics change? dynamic batch threshold or auto-batcher tuning?
raj: Batcher unchanged. We flipped the KV prefetcher to conservative in deploy abcd123 (https://github.com/redwood/inference/commit/abcd123)
dmitri: Prefetcher -> could increase memory contention if it issues overlapping loads. Also can surface bank conflict patterns. Try reducing tileM or lowering pipeline stages.
elaine: Quick test config to try:
```
kernel_config:
  tile_m: 48
  tile_n: 32
  pipeline_stages: 2
  block_y: 2
  kv.prefetch: enabled
```
raj: I'll run A/B: tile_m=48 + prefetch=on vs baseline tile_m=64 + prefetch=off
perf-bot: Benchmark queued: job/2934-run2, estimate ~22m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: Also enable kv.trace.evictions and capture top-keys during the run (`kv.cache.debug=true`)
raj: Attached short eviction sample from logs: `hotkey:user:123` evicted 14 times during 10s burst, many small keys thrashing LRU.
sam: :thumbsup: Also try disabling fused path to isolate whether attention fusion + prefetch causes the regress
dmitri: If eviction patterns persist, consider increasing shard size or extend lru_window_ms. Might be cheaper than kernel retuning.
elaine: If mem BW is pegged, try staggered prefetching (smaller prefetch window) to smooth bursts.
raj: ok running now. I'll post results in ~30m. thanks everyone :rocket:
